# Seema

> Seema (سيمة) is a branding, website, mobile app, and ERP company in Doha, Qatar. Seema helps businesses in Qatar and the Gulf grow with a stronger brand, a better digital experience, and smarter systems, in Arabic and English.

- Address: 7th Floor, Al Gassar Tower, West Bay, Doha, Qatar
- Phone: +974 6634 5802
- Email: hello@seema.qa
- Hours: Sunday to Thursday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
- Founded: 2026
- Legal name: Seema for Consultations, Digital Services and Website Design
- Arabic site: https://seema.qa/ar/

## Products
- Seema One: business platform for Qatar (HR, WPS payroll, finance, sales, projects, operations)
- RFID solutions: tracking for assets, files, vehicles, staff, libraries, patrols, stock, and jewellery
